Summary

On a Radxa Cubie A7A (Allwinner A733), the onboard UFS slot fails to bring up a UFS module. The system boots fine from
microSD, but the UFS controller never completes PHY setup, so the module never enumerates (no /dev/sda, no SCSI

timeout → Phy setup failed (-110) (ETIMEDOUT), retried 4 times, then UFS_EVT_LINK_STARTUP_FAIL.

third-party/compatibility problem. The same failure occurs on both RadxaOS and Armbian images.
